arxiv-2101-11038.title: Muppet: Massive Multi-task Representations with Pre-Finetuning
arxiv-2101-11038.creator: Armen Aghajanyan, Anchit Gupta, Akshat Shrivastava, Xilun Chen, Luke Zettlemoyer, Sonal Gupta
arxiv-2101-11038.description: Abstract We propose pre-finetuning, an additional large-scale learning stage between language model pre-training and fine-tuning. Pre-finetuning is massively multi-task learning (around 50 datasets, over 4.8 million total labeled examples), and is designed to encourage learning of representations that generalize better to many different tasks. We show that pre-finetuning consistently improves performance for pretrained discriminators (e.g. RoBERTa) and generation models (e.g.

arxiv-2111-07975.title: Semantically Grounded Object Matching for Robust Robotic Scene Rearrangement
arxiv-2111-07975.creator: Walter Goodwin, Sagar Vaze, Ioannis Havoutis, Ingmar Posner
arxiv-2111-07975.description: Abstract Object rearrangement has recently emerged as a key competency in robot manipulation, with practical solutions generally involving object detection, recognition, grasping and high-level planning. Goal-images describing a desired scene configuration are a promising and increasingly used mode of instruction.

arxiv-2112-04256.title: Solving graph equipartition SDPs on an algebraic variety
arxiv-2112-04256.creator: Tianyun Tang, Kim-Chuan Toh
arxiv-2112-04256.description: Abstract Semidefinite programs are generally challenging to solve due to their high dimensionality. Burer and Monteiro developed a non-convex approach to solve linear SDP problems by applying its low rank property. Their approach is fast because they used factorization to reduce the problem size.

arxiv-2211-04722.title: Cogenesis of visible and dark sector asymmetry in a minimal seesaw framework
arxiv-2211-04722.creator: Utkarsh Patel, Lekhika Malhotra, Sudhanwa Patra, Urjit A.Yajnik
arxiv-2211-04722.description: Abstract Recently there is a renewed interest in exploring the Dark sector of the universe in a more constrained way. Particularly in Datta et al. 2021 , the FIMP ( Feebly Interacting Massive Particle) scenario was shown to be realized with a minimal extension of the SM with three sterile neutrinos in the spirit of ν \nu MSM.

arxiv-2302-08950.title: Handling the Alignment for Wake Word Detection: A Comparison Between Alignment-Based, Alignment-Free and Hybrid Approaches
arxiv-2302-08950.creator: Vinicius Ribeiro 1,2 , Yiteng Huang 1 , Yuan Shangguan 1 , Zhaojun Yang 1 , Li Wan 1 , Ming Sun 1
arxiv-2302-08950.description: Abstract Wake word detection exists in most intelligent homes and portable devices. It offers these devices the ability to “wake up” when summoned at a low cost of power and computing. This paper focuses on understanding alignment’s role in developing a wake-word system that answers a generic phrase. We discuss three approaches.

arxiv-2311-03708.title: Endomorphism monoid and automorphism group of residually finite and profinite quandles
arxiv-2311-03708.creator: Manpreet Singh
arxiv-2311-03708.description: Abstract . We explore residually finite and profinite quandles. We prove that the endomorphism monoid and the automorphism group of finitely generated residually finite quandles are residually finite. In fact, we establish the similar result for a broad class of residually finite quandles. We provide a topological characterization of profinite quandles.

arxiv-2401-02710.title: Synergistic Formulaic Alpha Generation for Quantitative Trading based on Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2401-02710.creator: Hong-Gi Shin, Sukhyun Jeong, Eui-Yeon Kim, Sungho Hong, Young-Jin Cho, Yong-Hoon Choi
arxiv-2401-02710.description: Abstract Mining of formulaic alpha factors refers to the process of discovering and developing specific factors or indicators (referred to as alpha factors) for quantitative trading in stock market. To efficiently discover alpha factors in vast search space, reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly employed.

arxiv-2501-10150.title: Dual Debiasing: Remove Stereotypes and Keep Factual Gender for Fair Language Modeling and Translation
arxiv-2501-10150.creator: Tomasz Limisiewicz, David Mareček, Tomáš Musil
arxiv-2501-10150.description: Abstract Mitigation of biases, such as language models’ reliance on gender stereotypes, is a crucial endeavor required for the creation of reliable and useful language technology. The crucial aspect of debiasing is to ensure that the models preserve their versatile capabilities, including their ability to solve language tasks and equitably represent various genders.

arxiv-2512-12534.title: Animus3D: Text-driven 3D Animation via Motion Score Distillation Conference: SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Conference Papers; December 15–18, 2025; Hong Kong, Hong Kong SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Conference Papers (SA Conference Papers ’25), December 15–18, 2025, Hong Kong, Hong Kong DOI: 10.1145/3757377.3763916 ISBN:
arxiv-2512-12534.creator: Qi Sun, Can Wang, Jiaxiang Shang, Wensen Feng, Jing Liao ∗
arxiv-2512-12534.description: Abstract . We present Animus3D , a text-driven 3D animation framework that generates motion field given a static 3D asset and text prompt. Previous methods mostly leverage the vanilla Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) objective to distill motion from pretrained text-to-video diffusion, leading to animations with minimal movement or noticeable jitter.

pmc-10554485.title: OR14-01 Contact Between Thyroglobulin Opposite Domains Assists Its Upstream Regions In Intracellular Trafficking For Thyroid Hormonogenesis
pmc-10554485.creator: Cintia E Citterio, Kookjoo Kim, Bhavana Rajesh, Kevin Pena, Oliver B Clarke, Peter Arvan
pmc-10554485.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Arvan: None.Thyroglobulin (Tg), must be released into the lumen of thyroid follicles to facilitate thyroid hormone synthesis. The Tg primary sequence (∼2,760 amino acids) includes regions I, II, III, as well as ∼570 residues of cholinesterase-like (ChEL) domain (which bears 47% similarity to acetylcholinesterase), folded as a globular protein with multiple contacts between different Tg regions. The ChEL domain is reported to function as an intramolecular chaperone assisting Tg region I.

pmc-10574281.title: Examination of an Online Cooking Education Program to Improve Shopping Skills, Attitudes toward Cooking, and Cooking Confidence among WIC Participants
pmc-10574281.creator: Dena R. Herman, Rachel Kimmel, Skye Shodahl, Jose H. Vargas
pmc-10574281.description: The present study examined if adapting the Cooking Matters (CM) curriculum to be used in an online format would improve participants’ shopping skills, attitudes toward cooking, and feelings of cooking confidence, similar to the traditionally offered method, which is conducted in person.

pmc-10642425.title: Coeliac artery avulsion secondary to high velocity blunt abdominal trauma: a case report
pmc-10642425.creator: Tegan J Kay, Zafreen Rahman, Korana Musicki, Noel Atkinson, Katherine Martin
pmc-10642425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Coeliac artery (CA) injuries are an extremely rare subset of blunt abdominal trauma with a reported incidence of only 0.01%. Patterns of CA injury include intimal tear, dissection, thrombosis and pseudoaneurysm, with the most rare being complete CA avulsion. These complex injuries pose a treatment challenge due to rapid blood loss and anatomical difficultly in achieving proximal and multiple points of distal vascular control.

pmc-11325396.title: Aromatic 2,2-Diphenylethylamine Ligand Exchange of FA0.9Cs0.1PbBr3 Perovskite Nanocrystals for High-Efficiency Pure Green Light-Emitting Diodes
pmc-11325396.creator: Shoki Mizoguchi, Shunsuke Sumikoshi, Haruka Abe, Yuta Ito, Ryohei Yamakado, Takayuki Chiba
pmc-11325396.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Perovskite nanocrystals (NCs) with long alkyl ligands cannot easily form high-quality composite films owing to their poor dispersibility in π-conjugated small molecules and polymer host materials. In this study, we demonstrated that the aromatic ligand exchange of mixed-cation FA0.9Cs0.1PbBr3 NCs using 2,2-diphenylethylamine (DPEA) can not only enable the fabrication of high-efficiency light-emitting diodes (LEDs) but also allows dispersibility in host materials.

pmc-11516745.title: Integrating telemedicine in European healthcare settings: Key enablers for healthcare professionals
pmc-11516745.creator: T Schmitt, K Habimana, A Gottlob, C Habl, M Rosińska, M Sønderskov Frydensberg, S Anker Gents, V Leclercq, M Delnord, M Van den Bulcke
pmc-11516745.description: BackgroundConducted as part of WP4 (Sustainability) of the eCAN Joint Action (JA), we aimed to understand the facilitating factors for the use of telemedicine services in healthcare organisations (HCOs) involved in cancer care, such as comprehensive cancer centres and hospitals.

pmc-11587668.title: Study on the therapeutic potential of induced neural stem cells for Alzheimer's disease in mice
pmc-11587668.creator: Qiongqiong Ji, Yuanhao Lv, Bei Hu, Yue Su, Imran Ibrahim Shaikh, Xu Zhu
pmc-11587668.description: Induced neural stem cells (iNSCs), which have similar properties to neural stem cells and are able to self-proliferate and differentiate into neural cell lineages, are expected to be potential cells for the treatment of neurodegeneration disease. However, cell therapy based on iNSCs transplantation is limited by the inability to acquire sufficient quantities of iNSCs.

pmc-11593427.title: In Silico Identification of the Laccase-Encoding Gene in the Transcriptome of the Amazon River Prawn Macrobrachium amazonicum (Heller, 1862)
pmc-11593427.creator: Gabriel Monteiro de Lima, Fernando Araújo Abrunhosa, Bruna Ramalho Maciel, Ítalo Lutz, Janieli do Socorro Amorim da Luz Sousa, Carlos Murilo Tenório Maciel, Cristiana Ramalho Maciel
pmc-11593427.description: Background: Macrobrachium amazonicum is an opportunistic and omnivorous species that primarily feeds on plant material. Recent studies have shown that Endo-β-1,4-glucanase and Endo-β-1,4-mannanase are expressed in the transcriptome of adult specimens, while juveniles are capable of digesting nutrients from purified cellulose in their diet.

pmc-13206985.title: Current Understanding of Probiotic Strains and Immune Function: From Gut Microbiota to Systemic Immunity
pmc-13206985.creator: Maciej Piotr Szota, Katarzyna Napiórkowska-Baran, Aleksandra Wojtkiewicz, Lidia Wydeheft, Adam Wawrzeńczyk, Józef Sławatycki, Paweł Treichel, Ewa Alska, Barbara Zyśk, Krzysztof Pałgan
pmc-13206985.description: Growing evidence indicates that the gut microbiota is a central regulator of systemic immunity, acting through epithelial barrier integrity, microbial metabolites, and bidirectional signaling with innate and adaptive immune cells. Within this framework, probiotics have attracted substantial interest as tools for immune modulation; however, their effects are not uniform and should not be generalized across species or formulations.

pmc-13238896.title: Dermoscopic Clues of Scurvy in Clinical Practice
pmc-13238896.creator: Sunil Jaiswal, Shraddha Uprety, Pratichya Thapa, Prakriti Lamichhane
pmc-13238896.description: Scurvy often presents with subtle signs that are easily missed, potentially resulting in delayed or incorrect diagnosis. Diet history and underlying co‐morbidities should be assessed if there is suspicion of scurvy; dermoscopic clues can be used as a valuable non‐invasive tool for early detection in comparison to histopathological examination.

pmc-13434003.title: Neuron-targeting piezoelectric microneedles disrupt pro-tumorigenic neuron-immune crosstalk and restore anti-tumor immunity in melanoma
pmc-13434003.creator: Anjun Song, Yanjie Zhang, Yanjun Ji, Heying Yuan, Jinsong Ren, Xiaogang Qu

pmc-13503811.title: Novel CDK-independent function of CDC25 phosphatases in mRNA translation
pmc-13503811.creator: Sauyeun Shin, Marie Cargnello, Lisa Pinchedé, Claire Medale Giamarchi, Cléa Villette, Alexandre Gay, Virginie Salnot, Emilie-Fleur Gautier, Erik Dassi, Stefania Millevoi, Anne Cammas, Stéphane Manenti
pmc-13503811.description: Molecular and functional networks driving coordination between cell cycle and mRNA translation remain to be explored. Here, we use mass spectrometry-based proteomics to comprehensively investigate the interactome and phosphoproteome of the cell cycle regulator CDC25A. We identify actors of mRNA regulation, such as RNA-binding proteins and translation factors, as interacting partners of CDC25A.

pmc-13664725.title: Short‐Term Outcomes of Transanal Total Mesorectal Excision for Rectal Cancer: A Multicenter Propensity Score‐Matched Analysis Comparing Patients With and Without Preoperative Neoadjuvant Therapy
pmc-13664725.creator: Takafumi Shima, Hiroki Hamamoto, Takeru Matsuda, Ichiro Takemasa, Keitaro Tanaka, Toshiki Mukai, Jun Watanabe, Sang‐Woong Lee, Seiichiro Yamamoto, Takeshi Naitoh, Akihiro Kondo, Akihiro Kondo, Akinobu Taketomi, Akiyoshi Kanazawa, Atsushi Ogura, Chikayoshi Tani, Gunpei Yoshimatsu, Hideki Endo, Hideya
pmc-13664725.description: AimTo evaluate the association between preoperative neoadjuvant therapy and short‐term outcomes of transanal total mesorectal excision for rectal cancer.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed patients who underwent transanal total mesorectal excision at 26 Japanese institutions between 2012 and 2019. Patients who received neoadjuvant therapy were matched 1:1 with patients who did not. Perioperative, postoperative, and pathological outcomes were compared.
